description: Use AI to generate a complete email HTML template based on a description. Returns ready-to-use HTML that can be sent or used in campaigns.

apiKey.description: Send16 API key (overrides SEND16_API_KEY env var)

brandColor.description: Primary brand color as hex code (e.g. "#4F46E5")

companyName.description: Company or brand name to include in the template

description.description: Detailed description of the email content and purpose (e.g. 'Welcome email for a SaaS product with feature highlights and CTA to start trial')

type.description: Type of email template to generate

name: design_email_template
